rachael: ack. will shuffle slide order and give presenters a 90s handoff.

tom: yes, preview dropped during scene change. likely scene transition causing transcriber lag.
ops-bot: Tracing: transcriber queue spiked to 9s during scene change. Mitigation: throttle nonessential feeds and bump transcriber pool +2. Applying now.

lee: also legal note: recording retention default is 90 days. For extensions, legal approval + exec note required. link: https://intranet/redwood/legal/recordings
rachael: Audio check: low hum detected on channel floor-mic. switching to backup DI now.
ops-bot: Switched to DI-3. Hum reduced. Audio levels stable.
tom: Demo laptop black-screen fixed by forcing `xrandr --output HDMI1 --auto` — patch applied.
captioners-bot: Captions recovered. Lag ~2s now.
lee: Good. Post-meeting: everyone drop action items here: final recording link, captions (.vtt), perf snapshot id for the demo baseline, and any Qs needing written follow-up.
pm-lead: I'll paste the perf snapshot id after export (format: snapshot-YYYY-MM-DD-xxxx).
legal: Reminder: if leadership wants extension beyond 90 days, email legal@redwood with reason.
rachael: Ready to roll. Keep this thread for follow-up items only after the meeting. Thanks!
